#### ADOCS-02 · تدقيق CLAUDE.md وAGENTS.md وتخفيف السياق · Audit CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md for context diet · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يدقق ملفات سياق الوكلاء في المستودع، وينقل المحتوى الدائم الثقيل إلى مهارات عند الطلب أو وثائق مرتبطة، ويزامن ملفات التعليمات بين الأدوات من مصدر واحد. — Audit repository agent-context files, move always-loaded bulk into on-demand skills or linked docs, and keep per-tool instruction files in sync from one source.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** CLAUDE.md feels bloated or ignored, an agent repeats the same project mistake, quality drops in long sessions, or the team wants one instruction source for several AI tools.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Inventory CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules, Copilot instructions and .claude/rules. 2) Classify each block: always-needed, task-specific (make it a skill), heavy reference (link a doc), or delegated work (subagent). 3) Cut long or ignored sections; keep short, testable rules about repeated mistakes. 4) Add pointers so every context file stays small and loads on demand. 5) Generate per-tool files from one config (AGENTS.md from a sources list) and verify they match. 6) Capture recurring corrections as new rules. **أرقام / params:** repo path; target tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot); size budget
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ADOCS-03 · مزامنة ذاكرة التعليمات دون تضخم مع تحقق مستقل · Non-growth instruction-memory sync with independent verify · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** توليد مهارة مزامنة ذاكرة محلية تقارن CLAUDE.md والقواعد وملفات الوكلاء بالشيفرة، فتصلح الحقائق القديمة أولاً ثم تزيل التكرار وتضغط دون أن يكبر أي ملف، مع وكلاء تحقق مستقلين. — Generate a project-local memory-sync skill that diffs CLAUDE.md, rules and agent files against the code, repairs stale facts first, then dedups and compresses so no file grows, with separate verifier agents re-checking every edit.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** CLAUDE.md or rules drifted from the code; too much always-loaded context; after a branch or commit range changed behavior; requests like 'sync memory', 'slim context', 'clean up agent config'.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Resolve the mode (status|install|upgrade|...|purge) from the prompt; print a PLAN block; ask only if destructive. 2) Enumerate the memory surface by command; split into disjoint batches. 3) GATHER: read-only agents list change facts for the scope (session|branch|commit|all). 4) SYNC: one bounded agent per batch, all spawned in one message; facts first, dedup second, compression third; every file ends at or below its line count. 5) VERIFY: a different read-only agent per edited batch re-checks each fact in code and that removed facts are gone. 6) HARD depth: audit rule path globs (TOO_BROAD/TOO_NARROW/DANGLING/MISSING) and purge what a model already knows. 7) Report in chat only. **أرقام / params:** scope (session|branch|commit <sha>|recent:N|all); depth (NORMAL|HARD); reach (MEMORY|REFS); free-text emphasis
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2096-brewdoc/7431-memory-sync-setup` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2098-brewtools/7442-context-slim` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/945-clean-up-agent-config/2230-clean-up-agent-config`

## واجهات API والخلفية — APIs, backends & auth

#### ADOCS-04 · إعداد تقرير TPAR للمقاولين في أستراليا · Australian TPAR contractor report prep · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يعد تفصيل TPAR السنوي بتحديد المقاولين وفحص ABN وفصل ضريبة GST وتسجيل الأخطاء في ورقة عمل. — Prepare an annual TPAR breakdown: identify reportable contractors, validate ABNs, split GST and log errors in a working paper.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Australian client in a reportable industry needs the contractor payments report.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pull a full year of supplier bills and direct payments. 2) Filter by reportable industries (construction, cleaning, courier, IT, road freight, security); mixed businesses apply the 10% of GST turnover test. 3) Validate ABN: 11 digits plus check digit. 4) Separate GST; report gross. 5) Aggregate per contractor (gross, GST, net, count, first/last date). 6) Error sweep: missing ABN, duplicates, employees in AP, materials-only. 7) Word working paper; deadline 28 August. **أرقام / params:** financial year, industry
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ADOCS-08 · مراجعة العقود بدليل بنود ومستويات مخاطر · Contract review with clause playbook and tiers · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يراجع العقد مقابل مواقف البنود المعيارية والبديلة والمرفوضة ويصنف الانحرافات ويستخرج الشروط. — Review a contract against standard/fallback/walk-away clause positions, flag material deviations by tier and extract key terms.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Incoming contract, NDA triage, redlines, approval routing.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ingest file (PDF/DOCX/TXT) and classify type. 2) Compare against clause library (liability, indemnity, IP, term, confidentiality). 3) Tier each deviation: within fallback, beyond fallback, walk-away; route to approver. 4) Optionally run parallel lenses (risk, plain-English, missing protections, compliance) and aggregate a 0-100 safety score. 5) Extract parties, value, dates, cap, governing law, renewal into schema. 6) State not legal advice. **أرقام / params:** contract text, playbook

## التصحيح — Debugging & diagnosis

#### ADOCS-12 · مراجعة ما بعد الحادث بلا لوم · Blameless postmortem with timeline and action items · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يكتب مراجعة بلا لوم بالجدول الزمني والسبب الجذري وبنود عمل متتبعة. — Writes a blameless postmortem: timeline, root cause, contributing factors and tracked actions.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** After SEV1/SEV2, outage over 15 min, data loss, or near-miss.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Draft within 1-2 days, meeting days 3-5, finalize day 5-7. 2) Frame as what conditions allowed it. 3) Timeline, impact, root cause plus contributing factors. 4) Action items with owner and due date. 5) Review patterns quarterly.

#### ADOCS-42 · الكتابة البسيطة: كلمات يومية وجمل كاملة · Plain writing: everyday words, complete sentences · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يكتب نصاً يُفهم من القراءة الأولى: كلمات شائعة، بلا مصطلحات مخترعة، بلا تفخيم فارغ، مع مثال قبل وبعد لكل قاعدة. — Writes text readable in one pass: common words, no invented jargon, no empty emphasis, with a before/after for each rule.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** اكتب ببساطة، نص واضح، بدون حشو / plain language, simple writing, remove fluff
- **كيف / how:** 1) Prefer the common word; avoid words AI tools overuse (delve, tapestry, landscape, robust, leverage). 2) No jargon or invented shorthand; if a term is not in a standard dictionary, explain it. 3) Drop empty emphasis (really, pivotal, renowned, a testament to) and state the fact instead. 4) Complete sentences, one idea each, short paragraphs. 5) Revise by reading once as a newcomer and fixing every place you had to reread.

#### ADOCS-43 · أنسنة النص بالكثافة لا بقائمة حذف · Humanize by density, with an over-correction guard · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يزيل علامات النص الآلي التي يلاحظها القراء (المفردات والبنية) بقياس كثافتها، دون وعد بتجاوز كاشفات الذكاء الاصطناعي. — Removes the AI tells readers notice (vocabulary, structure) by scoring their density, without promising to beat AI detectors.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** النص يبدو آلياً، أنسنة تغريدة / sounds like AI, humanize tweet, AI tells
- **كيف / how:** 1) Readers mostly cite vocabulary and sentence structure as tells; target those. 2) Score suspect words by density per length instead of deleting a fixed list. 3) Cap em dashes rather than banning them; treat forced rhythm (triplets, staccato fragments) as a tell, not a fix. 4) Add an over-correction guard: do not strip natural phrasing or facts while removing tells. 5) Be honest that rewrites do not make text pass trained detectors; on short texts their scores are noise.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ADOCS-49 · كتابة README يجذب المطور في ثلاث ثوانٍ ويشغله في دقيقة · README that hooks in 3 seconds and runs in 60 · 📄 موصوف / documented only

#### ADOCS-50 · تعليقات الكود الملائمة: معلومة لا يحملها الكود · Appropriate code comments: information the code cannot carry · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحكم على كل تعليق: هل يضيف معلومة عن الحالة الحالية لا يقولها الكود نفسه؟ ويحوّل وعود 'لا تغيّر هذا' إلى اختبارات. — Judges each comment by whether it adds present-tense information the code itself cannot say, and turns 'do not change this' promises into tests.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مراجعة أو كتابة تعليقات، تنظيف كود قبل الدمج / writing or reviewing comments, cleaning code before merge
- **كيف / how:** 1) Keep a comment only when it states something the code cannot: a non-obvious why, a unit, a caller obligation such as lock ownership. 2) Cap it near two lines; longer rationale belongs in the commit or a design note. 3) Delete restatements of the code, change-history narration and ticket chatter. 4) Editor-test each instruction addressed to a future editor ('never lower this', 'keep in step with X'): nothing enforces it, so write a test named after the invariant (e.g. refund-not-applied-twice), not after the incident. 5) Test files are exempt from the cap where explaining a scenario helps.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2854-appropriate-comments-code/11563-appropriate-comments-code`

#### ADOCS-46 · دمج بيانات JSON في قوالب Word وExcel وPowerPoint · JSON-to-document templating (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/PDF) · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يملأ قالب مستند مكتبي من بيانات JSON بوسوم وحلقات وشروط ومنسّقات دون إعادة تشكيل البيانات. — Fills an office template from JSON with tags, loops, conditions and formatters, adapting the template rather than the data.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** فاتورة أو عقد أو تقرير من JSON، دمج بريدي، تحويل DOCX/HTML إلى PDF / invoice, contract or report from JSON, mail merge, document conversion
- **كيف / how:** 1) Keep the API JSON as is; shape output in the template with filters, sort, lookups and computed values. 2) Placeholders reach data by path; a loop is declared by a row with [i] and closed by a row with [i+1], which is removed from the output; nest loops freely. 3) Chain formatters for text, numbers, currency and dates; set language and time zone once as template options. 4) Use inline show/elseShow for words and Begin/End blocks for sections. 5) Never invent syntax from Mustache/Jinja: if the engine's documentation does not show it, say it does not exist. 6) Render a sample and check totals, empty arrays and locale formatting before delivery. **أرقام / params:** template format, dataset
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`pip:office`](../requirements.md#req-pip-office)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under Apache-2.0; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ADOCS-47 · تنقيح المستندات حقًا وإثبات ما سُلِّم ببصمات sha256 · True redaction and a sha256 delivery manifest · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحذف النص الحساس فعليًا (لا مربع أسود فوقه) ثم يثبت ما سُلّم ببيان بصمات قابل للتحقق. — Removes sensitive text for real (not a black box over it) and proves what was delivered with a verifiable hash manifest.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** إزالة بيانات شخصية من ملفات قبل مشاركتها، تسليم يحتاج أثر سلامة / removing PII before sharing, a deliverable that needs an integrity trail
- **كيف / how:** 1) Text formats: replace matches and diff source against output; grep for each pattern must return 0; make zero matches an error in scripts. 2) PDFs: a box drawn over text leaves it extractable; rasterise each page, paint the match and write a PDF with no text layer; tell the user it is now unsearchable, larger and without metadata. 3) Verify by extracting text from the output (should be empty); re-OCR only if searchability is needed and grep the OCR text again for near misses. 4) Write a sha256 manifest of the delivered files (optionally GPG-signed) and verify it; a manifest proves the bytes, not that redaction was complete. 5) Never overwrite a manifest; write v2. Originals stay untouched. **أرقام / params:** patterns, output dir
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`tesseract`](../requirements.md#req-tesseract)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ADOCS-51 · جولات CodeTour في الكود موجّهة لشخصية القارئ · Persona-targeted CodeTour walkthroughs with verified anchors · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يكتب ملفات .tour لإضافة CodeTour: جولة قصصية خطوة بخطوة في المستودع لشخص محدد (منضم جديد، مراجع PR، محقق سبب جذري، معماري، مراجع أمان)، كل خطوة مربوطة بملف وسطر حقيقيين، دون تعديل أي كود. — Writes CodeTour .tour files: a narrative, persona-specific walkthrough anchored to real files and lines, without touching source.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تأهيل مطوّر جديد، شرح PR، شرح كيف يعمل جزء من النظام، جولة لتحقيق في عطل / onboarding, PR walkthrough, explaining a subsystem, RCA tour
- **كيف / how:** 1) Explore first: root listing, README, config, languages, frameworks, entry points, 1–2 levels of folders. 2) Infer persona and depth from the request (PR → reviewer, 'why did X break' → RCA, 'onboarding' → new joiner, 'architecture' → architect deep); default new joiner, standard depth. 3) Read every file you will point to and verify each path and line; a wrong line is worse than no tour. 4) Use step types deliberately: at most two content-only steps (intro/close), directory steps to orient, file+line as the workhorse, selection for blocks, pattern anchors for volatile files, URI steps for PRs/issues/docs. 5) Size: quick 5–8 steps, standard 9–13, deep 14–18. 6) Write each description as: what this is, why it matters, how it connects, and what to look at next. 7) Save as .tours/<persona>-<focus>.tour. #### ADOCS-52 · تدقيق نصوص التعليمات الموجهة للنموذج: نواهٍ تلفت الانتباه وأمثلة تقيّد · LLM-facing prose audit: priming prohibitions and anchoring examples · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يراجع ملفات المهارات وبرومبتات الوكلاء بحثًا عن نمطين يضعفان الاتباع: ذكر أفعال ممنوعة أو مسارات قديمة أو بدائل مرفوضة دون حاجة (يبقيها في انتباه النموذج)، وأمثلة few-shot تربط النموذج بحالات بعينها بدل المبدأ. قراءة فقط، والقرار للمؤلف. — Read-only audit of skill files and agent prompts for unnecessary prohibitions and anchoring few-shot examples.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** قبل نشر SKILL.md أو برومبت نظام، النموذج يفعل بالضبط ما نُهي عنه، مخرجات تقلد الأمثلة حرفيًا / before shipping a SKILL.md or system prompt, the model does the forbidden thing, outputs copy the examples
- **كيف / how:** 1) Scope: LLM-facing prose only (skill bodies, agent prompts, output styles); skip code fences, formal definition blocks and human-facing docs. 2) Prohibition pass: flag 'do not X', mentions of retired paths and named rejected alternatives; keep a mention only if it is load-bearing (a real hazard the model would otherwise take). 3) For each flagged line propose the positive rewrite: the current path plus its reason ('Use Y because Z'). 4) Anchoring pass: flag principles followed by example lists whose main effect is to pin the model to those instances; boundary test: would removing the example widen correct application without losing format reliability? 5) Propose a sharper principle instead of the examples; keep examples that define an output format or delimit scope. 6) Emit structured findings (file, line, type, proposed text, load-bearing yes/no) and write no fixes; the author decides. #### ADOCS-53 · مخطط كتاب بمواصفة لكل فصل و'كتاب مرجعي' يحفظ الاتساق · Book outline with per-chapter specs and a series bible · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مخطط كتاب مفصل بما يكفي لكتابة كل فصل دون اختراع بنية: لكل فصل غرض وحالة دخول وخروج للقارئ (والبطل)، وسحب يشد القارئ، ومحتوى (مشاهد أو ادعاءات بأدلة أو مفاهيم)، مع 'كتاب مرجعي' للشخصيات والمصطلحات والقواعد، وتحقق ونقطة موافقة المؤلف. — A chapter-by-chapter outline with entry/exit states and pull per chapter, plus a bible, validated and author-approved.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** كتابة رواية أو كتاب غير قصصي أو تقني طويل، مسودات فصول تتناقض، قبل البدء في الكتابة / writing a novel, nonfiction or technical book, chapters contradicting each other
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read the brief, style guide, ideas and source index first. 2) For each chapter specify: working title, purpose (what it changes for the reader; two chapters with the same purpose means one is redundant), entry state and exit state (what the reader or protagonist knows, wants, fears, believes), the pull (question or tension carrying the reader), and content: 2–5 scene seeds for fiction (situation, turn, stakes), claims with source IDs and an anchoring story for nonfiction, concepts and the code arc for technical books. 3) Draw a pacing map across chapters. 4) Start the bible: characters, places, terms, rules of the world or the argument, timeline. 5) Validate structure (score and issues); revise once if weak, then surface remaining issues to the author instead of iterating blindly. 6) Stop for author approval with the shape, chapter list, pacing map and top three risks; record the approval date. #### ADOCS-54 · بناء ونشر كتاب: EPUB وPDF عبر Pandoc مع epubcheck وبيانات النشر · Book publishing build: EPUB/PDF via Pandoc, epubcheck and metadata · 📄 موصوف / documented only

- **كيف / how:** 1) Gate in: a readiness report says pass and every chapter is final; a forced override is recorded. 2) Write metadata (title, author, language, identifiers, description, keywords) and front matter (title, copyright with optional AI-assistance line, dedication, epigraph) and back matter (about the author, acknowledgements, further reading, glossary, source index). Some stores require AI-generated-text disclosure at upload. 3) Build from the final drafts, never from editing notes. 4) Pre-process: strip each chapter's YAML front matter into temp copies (concatenated blocks collide), add two trailing spaces to poem lines to keep breaks, monospace PDF without TOC for screenplays, drop a missing cover key with a note, and set --resource-path so images resolve (list files explicitly on Windows). 5) Run pandoc to EPUB, PDF and the other requested formats. 6) Validate the EPUB with epubcheck and open the PDF to check fonts, images and page breaks. 7) Produce title candidates, cover concepts and a launch checklist as separate notes. #### ADOCS-55 · نشر مجموعة رقمية بعد بوابتي الحقوق والحساسية الثقافية · Publish a digital collection through rights and cultural-sensitivity gates · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** قبل نشر مقتنيات أو أرشيف على الإنترنت: بوابة حقوق (ملك عام، أو حقوق مُصرّح بها، أو غير مصرح فلا يُنشر إلا وصف وصورة مصغرة)، ثم بوابة حساسية ثقافية بالتشاور مع المجتمع المصدر، ثم قرار الوصول المفتوح أو المقيد بترخيص واضح، والبنية التقنية للنشر. — Rights gate, then community-consultation sensitivity gate, then the open-vs-restricted decision and the publishing stack.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** متحف أو مكتبة أو أرشيف يريد نشر مجموعته رقميًا، مواد حساسة ثقافيًا أو دينيًا، اختيار CC0 أم ترخيص مقيد / a museum, library or archive publishing a collection online
- **كيف / how:** 1) Rights gate per item: public domain (openness possible), in copyright with rights held or cleared (publish under a licence), in copyright and not cleared (metadata and thumbnail only until cleared). Never publish a full image you have not cleared. 2) Sensitivity gate: culturally or religiously sensitive or community-restricted material needs consultation with the source community, traditional-knowledge labels and restriction or context as they advise; this can override public-domain status. 3) Where rights and sensitivity allow, default toward openness (CC0 or CC-BY); otherwise publish under a clear licence with access terms and standard rights statements. 4) Choose the stack: digital asset management, an online catalogue, IIIF image delivery, and virtual exhibitions where useful. 5) Record decisions per item so they can be audited and revisited. ## أدوات MCP والتكاملات — MCP servers, tools & integrations

#### ADOCS-56 · صفحة حالة المشروع بتبويبات: تحديث بالفروق لا إعادة سرد، وكتلة حالة مضمنة في كل نسخة · Tabbed project status page: refresh by deltas, not re-narration, with a state block embedded in every render · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** صفحة حالة لمشروع أكبر من أن يتابَع من الذاكرة: نظرة عامة ومسارات عمل كعمود فقري، وتبويبات للقرارات والأسئلة فقط حين يوجد محتوى حقيقي، وملف إعداد لكل مشروع بمصادر الحالة الحية والمسؤولين، وتحديث يقرأ النسخة السابقة ويغير ما تغير فقط. — A living status artifact.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** صفحة حالة للمشروع، تقرير تقدم أسبوعي، تحديث لوحة المشروع / project status page or weekly update
- **كيف / how:** 1) Keep one config per project: name, slug, one-line description, audience, the page URL after first publish, live sources (repos and queries, trackers, docs), owners per workstream and where to ask, dated notes for future refreshes. 2) Pick tabs with real content only: Overview and Workstreams are the spine; Decisions, FAQ, Risks or Timeline earn a tab only when substantive. 3) Generate from one template, then reread the render for cut-off text and overflow before publishing. 4) Embed a JSON state block (as_of plus the facts shown) in every render. 5) Refresh: read the previous render, parse its state block, gather live again, update in place, and report what changed since as_of instead of rewriting the story. 6) Publish privately first, say who can open it, update the same URL on every refresh, and optionally register it on a project hub. 7) Reply with the link and the deltas. ## التخطيط والمواصفات — Planning, specs & decisions

#### ADOCS-57 · من محضر الاجتماع إلى سجل قرارات: القرار والسبب والبدائل المرفوضة والمسؤول والأسئلة المفتوحة · From meeting transcript to decision record: decision, rationale, rejected options, owner and open questions · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** بدل ملخص يسرد ما قيل بالترتيب، يستخرج من النص ما تقرر فعلًا مع سببه، والخيارات التي رُفضت صراحة ولماذا، ومن يملك كل إجراء وموعده، وما بقي معلقًا؛ وما لم يُحسم يُكتب معلقًا ولا يُخترع له قرار. — A decision log, not a chronological recap.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** لخص الاجتماع، محضر اجتماع، ماذا قررنا، تفريغ اجتماع إلى مهام / meeting notes to decisions
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read the whole transcript before writing. 2) Extract each decision with the exact numbers, dates and scope as stated, and the rationale given. 3) List options explicitly rejected and why, so they are not re-argued. 4) Assign each action an owner and a due date only when the transcript names them; otherwise mark owner or date missing. 5) Collect unresolved questions and who must answer them. 6) Flag conflicts between speakers instead of picking a side. 7) Order the output: decisions, rejected options, actions, open questions, then a two-line context; quote the source line for anything contested. #### ADOCS-58 · من المتطلبات إلى قصص جاهزة للتذاكر بسيناريوهات Gherkin، مع تدقيق جودة المتطلبات قبل التسليم · Requirements to ticket-ready stories with Gherkin scenarios, plus a requirements quality audit before handoff · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يفكك المتطلب المعتمد إلى أصغر قصص تحفظ النية (من أنا وماذا أريد ولماذا، وفق INVEST)، ويكتب لكل قصة سيناريو رئيسيًا يكون فيه Given حقيقة وWhen فعلًا واحدًا وThen نتيجة ملحوظة من الخارج، ويستبدل كلمات مثل 'بشكل صحيح' بنتيجة محددة، ويضيف أخطر الحالات البديلة؛ ويدقق المتطلبات في الغموض والاتساق وقابلية التتبع والاختبار. — Atomic stories and testable requirements.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** اكتب user stories، معايير قبول، Gherkin، راجع المتطلبات قبل التطوير / writing stories or auditing requirements
- **كيف / how:** 1) Set the evidence boundary: sources, stable requirement IDs, authoritative rules, assumptions, missing evidence. 2) Inventory actors, triggers, states, outcomes, constraints and unresolved decisions before rewriting anything. 3) Split into the smallest stories that keep the approved intent; check variations of actor or permission, state, validity or timing, repetition, empty input, cancellation, failure. 4) Each story: title, 'as a role I want an action so that a benefit', a link to the design, and acceptance criteria; it must be independent, negotiable, valuable, estimable, small and testable. 5) Primary Gherkin scenario: factual Given, a single When, an externally observable Then; replace 'gracefully', 'properly', 'successfully' with the concrete result. 6) Add the highest-risk alternate, failure and boundary scenarios, not every permutation. 7) For backlog items written as Why-What-Acceptance, tie the why to an objective and keep acceptance high-level. 8) Audit requirements: classify as business, stakeholder or solution level, trace each to its source and to a test, and mark each check pass, fail, unknown or not applicable with blocker, major or minor severity for ambiguity, conflicts, missing conditions and untestable wording. #### ADOCS-59 · التطوير بالمواصفة للوكلاء: دستور ثم مواصفة بلا تقنية ثم صيد الغموض ثم خطة ثم مهام، ودمج تغييرات المواصفة في الأساس · Spec-driven development for coding agents: constitution, tech-free spec, ambiguity hunt, plan, tasks, and merging delta specs into the baseline · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** المواصفة لا الـprompt هي مصدر الحقيقة الدائم: مبادئ المشروع غير القابلة للتفاوض، ثم مواصفة تقول ماذا ولماذا دون تقنية بمعايير قبول بصيغة EARS، ثم صيد الغموض بأسئلة مع افتراض موصى به، ثم خطة تُفحص مقابل المبادئ، ثم مهام صغيرة مرتبة، ثم مزامنة المواصفة مع ما بُني فعلًا؛ ومواصفة جاهزة للوكيل في صفحة إلى ثلاث صفحات. — Tool-agnostic SDD loop with human gates.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** اكتب مواصفة لميزة، جهّز المتطلبات لوكيل برمجة، Spec Kit أو Kiro، الوكيل بنى الشيء الخطأ / spec-first work with coding agents
- **كيف / how:** 1) Detect the toolchain (.specify for Spec Kit, .kiro/specs for Kiro, AI-DLC rules) and follow it; otherwise create specs/<feature>/. 2) Constitution once per project: 5 to 9 principles drawn from the repo (test commands, architecture patterns, banned practices), approved by the tech lead. 3) Specify what and why with no technology; move tech choices to the plan. Write user stories with EARS criteria (WHEN a trigger, the system SHALL a response; WHILE a state; IF an unwanted condition THEN), non-functional needs and explicit out-of-scope. 4) Agent-ready spec: intent over instructions, explicit non-goals and forbidden actions, every requirement mapped to a check an agent can run, point to files and ADRs by path, 1 to 3 pages. 5) Clarify before planning: model actors, entities, states and external systems, then hunt scope, data, states and errors, permissions, concurrency, non-functional (including RTL), compatibility and contradictions; each finding becomes a question with a recommended default and the impact if wrong, ranked blocking, important, minor; check the code before asking; record answers in a dated Clarifications section. 6) Plan with a constitution check that lists each principle and compliance. 7) Tasks of 1 to 4 hours each with a verification step, independent ones marked [P], ordered by dependency with tests first. 8) Implement task by task and verify each. 9) Converge: merge delta specs into the main spec by operation (added appends, modified replaces by requirement name, removed deletes, renamed checks for collisions), flag conflicts for the owner, and archive only when clean. #### ADOCS-60 · قائمة الأعمال المؤجلة في المستودع: ملف لكل بند، وحقل يستحق نعم أو لا أو لاحقًا، والإغلاق بحذف الملف في git · In-repo backlog of deferred work: one file per item, a worth yes/no/later field, closed by deleting the file in git · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مجلد docs/backlog يحفظ العمل الحقيقي غير المنفذ الآن: عيب لم يُدخله التغيير الحالي، انحراف بلا عرض ظاهر، إصلاح أكبر من قيمته، فكرة تستحق الحفظ؛ لكل بند ملف باسم العيب نفسه، وثلاثة حقول فقط، و'لا' تُحفظ حتى لا يُكتشف البند ويُناقش من جديد. — A dedupe-friendly backlog that never gates work.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** سجل المهام المؤجلة، ماذا على قائمتي، أجّل هذا الإصلاح، اكتشاف مكرر لنفس المشكلة في كل مراجعة / tracking deferred work in a repo
- **كيف / how:** 1) Store items at docs/backlog/<slug>.md, where the slug names the defect (not the file), so commits can cite it and dedupe is a filename check. 2) Three front-matter fields: worth (yes = agreed it should be fixed, regardless of schedule; later = the value decision itself is open, and the body must name the unknown that settles it; no = decided not to fix, with the reason, kept only while that reason still matters), where (path:line when anchored; the line is only a navigation hint), added (YYYY-MM-DD, never updated, so it reads as age). 3) The H1 is the title; the body is free-form (repro, what was tried, links). 4) Before adding, search slugs and where paths for an existing item and append to it instead. 5) Close an item by git rm in the commit that fixes it. 6) List items ordered by worth then age. 7) It is the maintainer's own list; it never blocks a change or reaches contributors.
